coverage: 34 first-level units (25 provinces, nine centrally governed cities after the September 2026 status changes) and all 3,321 commune-level units under the two-tier system operating since July 2025. No abolished districts are introduced. Official unit codes and English/Vietnamese names from the retained September 2026 code list; July 2026 GIS export from the national mapping publisher through the attributed MIT dataset. The source includes Vietnamese claims to offshore island groups; mapped geometry follows this source and is not a determination of sovereignty. Local detail loads only per province; full retained resolution is available at close zoom. Published administrative population is included where a matching post-merger government series is available; missing figures are not estimated. Offshore Paracel and Spratly administrative sea/reef envelopes are replaced with retained detailed OpenStreetMap dry-land coastline inside the source envelopes; claims remain explicitly described.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds.
